payload.text: **hv, 28 Oct: every security finding is filed as an issue.** hv: "Any security issues need to be properly filed. We're just not fixing them now unless they're showstopper P0s." A finding parked in a note, a board line or a review remark is filed in its own project, deferred in its body unless it is a showstopper P0, and a P0 is named to hv. Relayed to every VC 28 Oct; filed in that round: Utilz 0126, Conflab 0015 and 0016, Laksa 0057, Gtools 0126, 0127 and 0128.
